schema_description: A/B testing experiments. Each key is an experiment name; the value is either an array of two or more variant strings (bare-array form) or an object with a 'variants' field plus optional metadata fields (description, metric, weight, issue, start_date, end_date, hypothesis, secondary_metrics, guardrail_metrics, min_samples, analysis_type, decision). The reserved 'storage' key controls how experiment state is persisted: 'repo' (default) commits state to a git branch named 'experiments/{sanitizedWorkflowID}' (workflow ID lowercased with hyphens removed) for durability; 'cache' uses GitHub Actions cache. At runtime the activation job picks a variant and persists the updated counters. Use ${{ experiments.<name> }} in the workflow prompt to reference the selected variant. When multiple experiments are declared, assignments are statistically balanced using a least-used counter that round-robins across variants (or weighted when 'weight' is provided); ties are broken randomly so no variant is systematically favoured on the first run.

Storage backend for experiment state. 'repo' (default) persists state to a git branch named 'experiments/{sanitizedWorkflowID}' (workflow ID lowercased with hyphens removed, e.g. 'my-workflow' -> 'experiments/myworkflow') for durability across cache evictions. 'cache' uses GitHub Actions cache (legacy behavior). Repo storage is recommended because experiment data is valuable and more durable than cache.

Feature flags and configuration options for experimental or optional features in the workflow. Each feature can be a boolean flag or a string value. The 'action-tag' feature (string) specifies the tag or SHA to use when referencing actions/setup in compiled workflows (for testing purposes only). The 'intentional-failure' feature (boolean) marks the workflow as one that is intentionally expected to fail (e.g., guardrail stress-tests); such workflows are excluded from fleet-health and prod-main success-rate rollups.

schema_description: Scheduled trigger events using fuzzy schedules or standard cron expressions. Supports shorthand string notation (e.g., 'daily', 'daily around 2pm') or array of schedule objects. Fuzzy schedules automatically distribute execution times to prevent load spikes.

schema_description: Skip workflow execution when an event-specific payload author_association field (for example: github.event.comment.author_association, github.event.issue.author_association, github.event.pull_request.author_association) matches configured associations for specific events. Keys are event names (for example: issue_comment, pull_request_review_comment, issues, pull_request). Values accept a single string or an array of strings. Association values are case-insensitive in frontmatter.
rationale: Impide que el workflow corra según la relación del autor con el repositorio, lo que restringe quién activa al agente

schema_description: Skip workflow execution for specific GitHub users. Useful for preventing workflows from running for specific accounts (e.g., bots, specific team members).
rationale: Impide que el workflow corra para usuarios específicos, lo que restringe quién activa al agente

schema_description: Skip workflow execution if any CI checks on the target branch are failing or pending. Accepts true (check all) or an object to filter specific checks by name and optionally specify a branch or allow pending checks.
rationale: Decide si el workflow corre según el estado del CI, sin restringir quién activa al agente
notes: Responde a la estabilidad del CI más que a la seguridad

schema_description: Conditionally skip workflow execution when a GitHub search query has matches. Can be a string (query only, implies max=1) or an object with 'query', optional 'max', and 'scope' fields. Use top-level on.github-token or on.github-app for custom authentication.
rationale: Decide si el workflow corre según los resultados de una búsqueda, sin restringir quién activa al agente

schema_description: Conditionally skip workflow execution when a GitHub search query has no matches (or fewer than minimum). Can be a string (query only, implies min=1) or an object with 'query', optional 'min', and 'scope' fields. Use top-level on.github-token or on.github-app for custom authentication.
rationale: Decide si el workflow corre según la falta de resultados en una búsqueda, sin restringir quién activa al agente

schema_description: Skip workflow execution for users with specific repository roles. Useful for workflows that should only run for external contributors or specific permission levels.

rationale: Es un disparador que decide cuándo corre el workflow a partir de un comando en un comentario, sin restringir quién puede escribirlo

schema_description: Controls the stale lock file check in the activation job. Set to false to disable the check, true (default) to enable frontmatter hash checking, or "full" to check both frontmatter and body hashes. Use "full" when prompt-body edits should also trigger recompilation detection. Useful when the workflow source files are managed outside the default GitHub repo context (e.g. cross-repo org rulesets) and the stale check is not needed (set false), or when comprehensive drift detection is required (set "full").
rationale: Verifica que el lock file corresponda al md, sin mencionar requisitos de seguridad ni restringir al agente
notes: Campo útil para el estudio: revisar si el hash aparece en los .lock.yml del dataset

schema_description: Status event trigger that runs when the status of a Git commit changes
rationale: Es un evento que dispara el workflow cuando cambia el estado de un commit, sin restringir quién activa al agente

schema_description: Whether to post status comments (started/completed) on the triggering item. Boolean form enables/disables status comments globally. rationale: Configura los comentarios de estado del job de activación, sin cambiar lo que el agente puede hacer o acceder

schema_description: Steps to inject into the pre-activation job. These steps run after all built-in checks (membership, stop-time, skip-if, etc.) and their results are exposed as pre-activation outputs. Use 'id' on steps to reference their results via needs.pre_activation.outputs.<id>_result.

schema_description: Time when workflow should stop running. Maximum values for time deltas: 12mo, 52w, 365d, 8760h (365 days). Note: Minute unit 'm' is not allowed for stop-after; minimum unit is hours 'h'.
rationale: Define cuándo vence el workflow, sin cambiar los privilegios ni los límites de seguridad del agente

rationale: Dispara el workflow, pero no configura los privilegios ni límites del agente

rationale: Dispara el workflow, pero no configura los privilegios ni límites del agente

schema_description: Permission for GitHub Actions workflows and runs (read: view workflows, write: manage workflows, none: no access)

schema_description: Permission shorthand that applies read access to all permission scopes. Can be combined with specific write permissions to override individual scopes. 'write' is not allowed for all.

schema_description: Runner topology configuration. schema_description: Runner execution topology. schema_description: Runner group name for self-hosted runners or GitHub-hosted runner groups
rationale: Elige el grupo de runners donde corre el workflow, sin configurar privilegios ni el aislamiento del agente

schema_description: List of runner labels for self-hosted runners or GitHub-hosted runner selection
rationale: Elige las etiquetas de la máquina donde corre el workflow, sin configurar privilegios ni el aislamiento del agente

schema_description: Runner type for workflow execution (GitHub Actions standard field). For agentic workflows, runner selection matters when AI workloads require specific compute resources or when using self-hosted runners with specialized capabilities. Typically configured at the job level instead. See https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/choosing-the-runner-for-a-job

rationale: Elige el grupo de runners donde corren algunos jobs del workflow, sin configurar privilegios ni el aislamiento del agente

schema_description: List of runner labels for self-hosted runners or GitHub-hosted runner selection
rationale: Elige las etiquetas de la máquina donde corren algunos jobs del workflow, sin configurar privilegios ni el aislamiento del agente

schema_description: Runtime environment version overrides. Allows customizing runtime versions (e.g., Node.js, Python) or defining new runtimes. Runtimes from imported shared workflows are also merged.

schema_description: Custom GitHub Actions to mount as once-callable MCP tools. schema_description: When set to false or "false", disables all activation and fallback comments entirely (run-started, run-success, run-failure, PR/issue creation links). Supports templatable boolean values including GitHub Actions expressions (e.g. ${{ inputs.activation-comments }}). Default: true

schema_description: Enable AI agents to add comments to GitHub issues, pull requests, or discussions. Supports templating, cross-repository commenting, and automatic mentions.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida comentar en issues, PR o discusiones, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to add labels to GitHub issues or pull requests based on workflow analysis or classification.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida agregar etiquetas a issues o PR, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to request reviews from users or teams on pull requests based on code changes or expertise matching.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida revisores en pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Experimental. Assign an Azure DevOps identity to a work item. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida asignar work items de Azure DevOps, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Experimental. Comment on explicitly scoped Azure DevOps work items. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida comentar en work items de Azure DevOps con alcance explícito, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Experimental. Create Azure DevOps work items through a trusted safe-output handler. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear work items de Azure DevOps mediante el job de safe outputs, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Experimental. Link explicitly scoped Azure DevOps work items. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Configura lo que el agente puede solicitar

schema_description: Experimental. Update explicitly scoped Azure DevOps work items and explicitly enabled fields. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Configura lo que el agente puede solicitar modificar

schema_description: Experimental. Upload a staged workspace file to an Azure DevOps work item. Using this field emits a compile-time warning.
rationale: Permite que el agente pueda solicitar subida de archivos, lo que configura sus acciones

schema_description: List of allowed domains for URL redaction in safe output handlers. Supports domain set identifiers (e.g., "python", "node", "default-safe-outputs", "copilot") like network.allowed. These domains are unioned with network.allowed when computing the final allowed domain set. localhost and github.com are always included.
rationale: Tiene consecuencias en los canales de salida que tiene disponible el agente

schema_description: List of allowed repositories for GitHub references (e.g., #123 or owner/repo#456). Use 'repo' to allow current repository. References to other repositories will be escaped with backticks. If not specified, all references are allowed.
rationale: Es una lista de repositorios a los que se puede referenciar, pero no define lo que puede hacerse con eso

schema_description: Enable AI agents to approve pending workflow runs in the action required state.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida aprobar ejecuciones de workflows pendientes, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to assign GitHub milestones to issues or pull requests based on workflow analysis or project planning.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida asignar milestones a issues o PR, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to assign issues or pull requests to GitHub Copilot (@copilot) for automated handling.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida asignar issues o PR a Copilot, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to assign issues or pull requests to specific GitHub users based on workflow logic or expertise matching.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida asignar issues o PR a usuarios, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create autofixes for code scanning alerts using the GitHub REST API.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear autofixes para alertas de code scanning, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Deterministic template appended to every safe output body, in addition to handler-specific body-footer content and independently of the generated attribution footer. Imported body footers are additive. Available placeholders: {workflow_name}, {run_url}.
rationale: Agrega un texto fijo al final de las salidas, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: Call reusable workflows via workflow_call fan-out. The compiler generates static conditional jobs; the agent selects which worker to activate. Use this for orchestrator/dispatcher patterns within the same repository.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida activar workflows del mismo repositorio, elegidos entre los definidos al compilar, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to close GitHub Discussions based on workflow analysis or conditions.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida cerrar discusiones, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to close GitHub issues based on workflow analysis, resolution detection, or automated triage.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida cerrar issues, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to close pull requests based on workflow analysis or automated review decisions.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida cerrar pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Concurrency group for the safe-outputs job. When set, the safe-outputs job will use this concurrency group with cancel-in-progress: false. Supports GitHub Actions expressions.
rationale: Define el grupo de concurrencia del job de safe outputs, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: Enable creation of GitHub Copilot coding agent sessions from workflow output. Allows workflows to start interactive agent conversations.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida abrir sesiones con el agente de código de Copilot, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable creation of GitHub Copilot coding agent tasks from workflow output. Allows workflows to spawn new agent sessions for follow-up work.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear tareas para el agente de código de Copilot, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create GitHub Check Runs that surface analysis results in the PR checks UI. Requires checks: write permission.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear check runs en pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create GitHub Advanced Security code scanning alerts for detected vulnerabilities or security issues.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear alertas de code scanning, lo que configura lo que puede crear
notes: * Campo interesante para los MD de seguridad

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create GitHub Discussions from workflow output. Supports categorization, labeling, and automatic closure of older discussions. Does not require 'discussions: write' permission.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear discusiones, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create GitHub issues from workflow output. Supports title prefixes, automatic labeling, assignees, and cross-repository creation. Does not require 'issues: write' permission.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear issues, incluso en otros repositorios, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create new GitHub Projects for organizing and tracking work across issues and pull requests.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear tableros de GitHub Projects, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to post status updates to GitHub Projects for progress tracking and stakeholder communication.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida publicar actualizaciones de estado en GitHub Projects, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create GitHub pull requests from workflow-generated code changes, patches, or analysis results.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida abrir pull requests con cambios de código, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to add review comments to specific lines in pull request diffs during code review workflows.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida comentar líneas específicas del diff de un pull request, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Structured data configuration for body-based safe outputs. Set false (or omit) to disable data, true to allow any object data, provide an inline schema object to enforce shape, or provide a GitHub Actions expression string that resolves to one of those forms at runtime.
rationale: Define si el agente puede adjuntar datos estructurados a sus salidas y qué forma deben tener, lo que configura un control sobre lo que produce

schema_description: Enable AI agents to dismiss pull request reviews authored by the current workflow actor.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida descartar revisiones hechas por el mismo workflow, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Dispatch repository_dispatch events to external repositories. Each sub-key defines a named dispatch tool with its own event_type, target repository, input schema, and execution limits. Note: nested keys use snake_case (event_type, allowed_repositories) rather than the kebab-case used by other safe-output fields.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida enviar eventos a otros repositorios, con destinos y límites definidos, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Dispatch workflow_dispatch events to other workflows. Used by orchestrators to delegate work to worker workflows with controlled maximum dispatch count.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida lanzar otros workflows, con un número máximo de despachos, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Environment variables to pass to safe output jobs
rationale: Define variables para el job de safe outputs, sin que la descripción indique que lleguen al agente

schema_description: Override the GitHub deployment environment for the safe-outputs job. When set, this environment is used instead of the top-level environment: field. When not set, the top-level environment: field is propagated automatically so that environment-scoped secrets are accessible in the safe-outputs job.
rationale: Elige el environment del job de safe outputs, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: Repository to create failure tracking issues in, in the format 'owner/repo'. Useful when the current repository has issues disabled. Defaults to the current repository. Supports GitHub Actions expressions (e.g. '${{ inputs.failure-issue-repo }}') so reusable workflows can let callers configure this at runtime.
rationale: Elige dónde se crean los issues automáticos de falla, que genera GH-AW y no el agente

schema_description: Global footer control for all safe outputs. When false, omits visible AI-generated footer content from all created/updated entities (issues, PRs, discussions, releases) while still including XML markers for searchability. Individual safe-output types (create-issue, update-issue, etc.) can override this by specifying their own footer field. Defaults to true.
rationale: Controla el pie visible de las salidas, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: GitHub App credentials for minting installation access tokens.
rationale: Credenciales para el job de safe outputs, sin que la descripción indique que lleguen al agente

schema_description: GitHub token expression for same-job contexts. Accepts a secrets expression (e.g., `${{ secrets.NAME }}` or `${{ secrets.NAME1 || secrets.NAME2 }}`), a cross-job output expression (e.g., `${{ needs.auth.outputs.token }}`), or a same-job step output expression with optional secret fallbacks (e.g., `${{ steps.fetch-token.outputs.my-token || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}`). Pattern details: secret names and job IDs match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`; same-job step IDs and output names match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*`.
rationale: Token para el job de safe outputs, sin que la descripción indique que llegue al agente

schema_description: When true, creates a parent '[aw] Failed runs' issue that tracks all workflow failures as sub-issues. Helps organize failure tracking but may be unnecessary in smaller repositories. Defaults to false.
rationale: Agrupa los issues automáticos de falla bajo un issue padre, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir

schema_description: Enable AI agents to minimize (hide) comments on issues or pull requests based on relevance, spam detection, or moderation rules.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida ocultar comentarios en issues o pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Override the id-token permission for the safe-outputs job. Use 'write' to force-enable the id-token: write permission (required for OIDC authentication with cloud providers). Use 'none' to suppress automatic detection and prevent adding id-token: write even when vault/OIDC actions are detected in steps. By default, the compiler auto-detects known OIDC/vault actions (aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials, azure/login, google-github-actions/auth, hashicorp/vault-action, cyberark/conjur-action) and adds id-token: write automatically.
rationale: Define el permiso id-token del job de safe outputs, sin que la descripción indique que llegue al agente

schema_description: Custom safe-output jobs that can be executed based on agentic workflow output. Job names containing dashes will be automatically normalized to underscores (e.g., 'send-notification' becomes 'send_notification').
rationale: Habilita jobs propios que el agente puede pedir ejecutar como salidas, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Experimental. Add comments to one trusted Linear issue through the isolated safe_outputs job.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida comentar en un issue de Linear de confianza, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Experimental. Create Linear issues through the isolated safe_outputs job.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida crear issues de Linear, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Linear API key expression resolved only in the trusted safe_outputs job.
rationale: Credencial de Linear que se resuelve solo en el job de safe outputs, sin llegar al agente

schema_description: Experimental. Update explicitly enabled fields on one trusted Linear issue through the isolated safe_outputs job.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida modificar campos habilitados de un issue de Linear de confianza, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to create hierarchical relationships between issues using GitHub's sub-issue (tasklist) feature.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida vincular issues como sub-issues, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to mark draft pull requests as ready for review when criteria are met.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida marcar pull requests en borrador como listos para revisión, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Maximum number of bot trigger references (e.g. 'fixes #123', 'closes #456') allowed in output before all of them are neutralized. Default: 10. Supports integer or GitHub Actions expression (e.g. '${{ inputs.max-bot-mentions }}').
rationale: Resuelto por consenso entre codificadores: configura el umbral desde el cual se neutralizan las referencias a bots en las salidas, un control sobre lo que produce el agente. No es un límite de tiempo, turnos, ejecuciones ni gasto.
notes: Justificación del primer codificador reemplazada por consenso. Nota original: Caso con dudas

schema_description: Maximum allowed number of unique files in a create-pull-request patch. Defaults to 100. The check counts unique file paths (deduplicated across multi-commit patches), so it reflects how many distinct files the agent is pushing in this iteration.
rationale: Resuelto por consenso entre codificadores: limita cuántos archivos puede incluir el agente en un parche, lo que restringe lo que puede escribir. No es un límite de tiempo, turnos, ejecuciones ni gasto.
notes: Justificación del primer codificador reemplazada por consenso. Nota original: Caso con dudas

schema_description: Maximum allowed size for git patches in kilobytes (KB). Defaults to 4096 KB (4 MB). If patch exceeds this size, the job will fail.
rationale: Resuelto por consenso entre codificadores: limita el tamaño de los parches que puede enviar el agente, lo que restringe lo que puede escribir. No es un límite de tiempo, turnos, ejecuciones ni gasto.
notes: Justificación del primer codificador reemplazada por consenso. Nota original: Caso con dudas

schema_description: Configuration for @mention filtering in safe outputs. Controls whether and how @mentions in AI-generated content are allowed or escaped.
rationale: Resuelto por consenso entre codificadores: configura el filtrado de las menciones en el contenido generado por el agente, un control sobre sus salidas.
notes: Justificación del primer codificador reemplazada por consenso. Nota original: Caso con dudas

schema_description: Enable AI agents to merge pull requests under configured policy gates.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida mergear pull requests bajo las condiciones configuradas, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Custom message templates for safe-output footer and notification messages. Available placeholders: {workflow_name} (workflow name), {run_url} (GitHub Actions run URL), {triggering_number} (issue/PR/discussion number), {workflow_source} (owner/repo/path@ref), {workflow_source_url} (GitHub URL to source), {operation} (safe-output operation name for staged mode).
rationale: Personaliza los textos de los pies y avisos que agrega GH-AW, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: Enable AI agents to report when required data or context is missing. Used for workflow troubleshooting and data validation.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida reportar datos o contexto faltante, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to report when required MCP tools are unavailable. Used for workflow diagnostics and tool discovery.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida reportar herramientas MCP no disponibles, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Explicit additional custom workflow jobs that the consolidated safe_outputs job should depend on.
rationale: Define jobs de los que depende el job de safe outputs, solo ordena la ejecución sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir

schema_description: Enable AI agents to explicitly indicate no action is needed. Used for workflow control flow and conditional logic.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida indicar que no hace falta ninguna acción, lo que configura las salidas que puede producir

schema_description: Enable AI agents to push commits directly to pull request branches for automated fixes or improvements.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida subir commits directamente a ramas de pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede escribir

schema_description: Enable AI agents to remove labels from GitHub issues or pull requests.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida quitar etiquetas de issues o pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to replace one label with another on GitHub issues or pull requests in a single atomic operation. Ideal for maintaining label-based state machines (e.g. transitioning issues through workflow states).
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida reemplazar una etiqueta por otra en issues o pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to reply to existing review comments on pull requests.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida responder comentarios de revisión en pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Controls whether to report failed non-builtin jobs as issues (default: true). Set to false to disable. Supports GitHub Actions expressions.
rationale: Controla si GH-AW abre issues por jobs propios que fallan, algo automático que no pide el agente

schema_description: Enable AI agents to signal that a task could not be completed due to infrastructure or tool failures (e.g., MCP crash, missing auth, inaccessible repository). Activates failure handling even when the agent exits 0.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida marcar su tarea como incompleta por fallas externas, lo que configura las salidas que puede producir

schema_description: Enable AI agents to resolve review threads on pull requests after addressing feedback. Supports cross-repository resolution via target, target-repo, and allowed-repos.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida marcar como resueltos hilos de revisión en pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Runner type for workflow execution (GitHub Actions standard field). Supports multiple forms: simple string for single runner label (e.g., 'ubuntu-latest'), array for runner selection with fallbacks, or object for GitHub-hosted runner groups with specific labels. For agentic workflows, runner selection matters when AI workloads require specific compute resources or when using self-hosted runners with specialized capabilities. Typically configured at the job level instead. See https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-jobs/choosing-the-runner-for-a-job
rationale: Elige la máquina donde corre el job de safe outputs, sin configurar lo que el agente puede pedir ni filtrar lo que produce

schema_description: Inline JavaScript script handlers that run inside the consolidated safe-outputs job handler loop. Unlike 'jobs' (which create separate GitHub Actions jobs), scripts execute in-process alongside the built-in handlers. Users write only the body of the main function — the compiler wraps it with 'async function main(config = {}) { ... }' and 'module.exports = { main };' automatically. Script names containing dashes will be automatically normalized to underscores (e.g., 'post-slack-message' becomes 'post_slack_message').
rationale: Resuelto por consenso entre codificadores: la descripción no indica si el agente puede pedir la ejecución de esos scripts, por lo que no se puede afirmar que le entreguen privilegios.
notes: Justificación del primer codificador reemplazada por consenso.

schema_description: Enable AI agents to set one issue field value by field name and value.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida cambiar el valor de un campo de un issue, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to set or clear the type of GitHub issues. Use an empty string to clear the current type.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida asignar o quitar el tipo de un issue, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: A boolean value that may also be specified as a GitHub Actions expression string that resolves to a boolean at runtime (e.g. '${{ inputs.my-flag }}').
rationale: La descripción solo indica el tipo de valor, sin decir qué configura ni si afecta al agente

schema_description: ⚠️ Experimental. Create a run-scoped issue and let the agent read user-authored issue comments containing the keyword 'steer'. The issue is reused for agent failure reporting. Requires top-level issues: read permission.
rationale: Permite que el agente lea comentarios de usuarios en un issue de la ejecución, lo que configura el contenido que puede recibir

schema_description: Custom steps to inject into all safe-output jobs. These steps run after checking out the repository and setting up the action, and before any safe-output code executes.
rationale: Agrega pasos al job de safe outputs antes de procesar las salidas, sin entregarle privilegios, canales ni credenciales al agente

schema_description: Enable AI agents to submit consolidated pull request reviews with a status decision. Works with create-pull-request-review-comment to batch inline comments into a single review.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida enviar revisiones de pull requests con una decisión, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to report detected security threats, policy violations, or suspicious patterns for security review.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida reportar amenazas o patrones sospechosos para revisión, lo que configura las salidas que puede producir
notes: La descripción del schema no calza con Security Architecture, donde threat-detection es un mecanismo que revisa la salida del agente con escáneres y un prompt propio, no una salida del agente

schema_description: Timeout for the safe_outputs job in minutes. Defaults to 45 minutes. Increase for workflows with many sequential safe output operations (e.g. push_to_pull_request_branch against large repositories).
rationale: Fija el tiempo máximo del job de safe outputs, un límite de tiempo que no configura privilegios ni controles de seguridad

schema_description: Enable AI agents to unassign users from issues or pull requests. Useful for reassigning work or removing users from issues.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida quitar la asignación de usuarios en issues o pull requests, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to edit and update existing GitHub Discussion content, titles, and metadata.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida editar discusiones existentes, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to edit and update existing GitHub issue content, titles, labels, assignees, and metadata.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida editar issues existentes, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to add items to GitHub Projects, update custom fields, and manage project structure. Use this for organizing work into projects with status tracking, priority management, and custom metadata.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida agregar y editar elementos en GitHub Projects, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to edit and update existing pull request content, titles, labels, reviewers, and metadata.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida editar pull requests existentes, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to edit and update GitHub release content, including release notes, assets, and metadata.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida editar releases, incluidas notas y archivos, lo que configura lo que puede hacer

schema_description: Enable AI agents to upload files as run-scoped GitHub Actions artifacts. Returns a temporary artifact ID rather than a raw download URL, keeping authorization centralized.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida subir archivos como artefactos de la ejecución, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: Enable AI agents to publish files (images, charts, reports) to an orphaned git branch for persistent storage and web access.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida publicar archivos en una rama del repositorio, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: ⚠️ Experimental. Enable AI agents to upload a code coverage report (e.g. a Cobertura XML file) to GitHub's code coverage API via actions/upload-code-coverage. Using this field emits a compile-time warning. The agent stages the report file and calls the tool with file/language/label; a separate job performs the actual upload with dedicated code-quality: write permissions.
rationale: Habilita que el agente pida subir reportes de cobertura de código, lo que configura lo que puede crear

schema_description: URL sanitization policy for safe outputs. "allowed-only" sanitizes all non-allowed URLs everywhere. "allowed-or-code-region" preserves URLs inside fenced and inline code regions while sanitizing prose.
rationale: Define cómo se ocultan las URL no permitidas en las salidas del agente, lo que configura un control sobre lo que produce

schema_description: Sandbox configuration for AI engines. Controls agent sandbox (AWF) and MCP gateway. The MCP gateway is always enabled and cannot be disabled.
rationale: Configura el sandbox del agente y el gateway MCP, lo que configura su aislamiento y sus canales

schema_description: Agent sandbox type: 'awf' uses AWF (Agent Workflow Firewall), or false to disable agent sandbox. Defaults to 'awf' if not specified. Note: Disabling the agent sandbox (false) removes firewall protection but keeps the MCP gateway enabled.
rationale: Activa o desactiva el sandbox con firewall donde corre el agente, lo que configura su aislamiento

schema_description: Legacy custom Sandbox Runtime configuration (use agent.config instead). Note: Network configuration is controlled by the top-level 'network' field, not here.
rationale: Configuración antigua del sandbox, sin indicar qué aspecto del aislamiento configura

schema_description: MCP Gateway configuration for routing MCP server calls through a unified HTTP gateway. Requires the 'mcp-gateway' feature flag to be enabled. Per MCP Gateway Specification v1.0.0: Only container-based execution is supported.
rationale: Configura el gateway por donde pasan las conexiones del agente a servidores MCP, lo que configura sus canales

schema_description: Legacy sandbox type field (use agent instead). Note: Legacy 'srt' and 'sandbox-runtime' values are automatically migrated to 'awf'
rationale: Versión antigua de sandbox.agent, elige el tipo de sandbox donde corre el agente, lo que configura su aislamiento

schema_description: Configuration for secret redaction behavior in workflow outputs and artifacts
rationale: Configura cómo se ocultan los secretos en las salidas y artefactos del workflow, lo que configura un control sobre lo que produce

schema_description: Additional secret redaction steps to inject after the built-in secret redaction. Use this to mask secrets in generated files using custom patterns.
rationale: Agrega pasos para ocultar secretos en archivos generados con patrones propios, lo que configura un control sobre lo que produce

schema_description: Secret values passed to workflow execution. Secrets can be defined as simple strings (GitHub Actions expressions) or objects with 'value' and 'description' properties. Typically used to provide secrets to MCP servers or custom engines. Note: For passing secrets to reusable workflows, use the jobs.<job_id>.secrets field instead.
rationale: Entrega secretos a servidores MCP o motores personalizados, y el motor se considera parte del agente

schema_description: Service containers for the job
rationale: Declara contenedores de servicio para el job, sin configurar privilegios, canales ni controles del agente

schema_description: Optional list of skill references to install during activation. Supports remote repository-wide installs (`owner/repo@<sha>`), remote path-scoped installs (`owner/repo/skill/path@<sha>`), and local path references (e.g. `skills/rig` or `.github/skills/my-skill`). Remote static references may use a full 40-character lowercase commit SHA, or a branch/tag name (resolved to a SHA at compile time). Omitting the ref (`owner/repo@`) opts out of pinning and triggers a compile-time warning. Local paths are installed with --from-local at runtime and are rewritten to a remote repospec by `gh aw add`. GitHub Actions expressions (`${{ ... }}`) are also accepted and are evaluated at runtime. Entries may also be objects to configure per-skill authentication via github-token or github-app.
rationale: Instala skills en la activación y fija su versión, sin configurar privilegios, canales ni controles del agente

schema_description: GitHub App credentials for minting installation access tokens.
rationale: Entrega credenciales de una GitHub App para autenticar la descarga de skills, sin indicar si el token llega al agente o al motor

schema_description: GitHub token expression for cross-job or activation-time contexts. Accepts a secrets expression (e.g., `${{ secrets.NAME }}` or `${{ secrets.NAME1 || secrets.NAME2 }}`) or a cross-job output expression (e.g., `${{ needs.auth.outputs.token }}`). Pattern details: secret names, job IDs, and output names in dot notation match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` (identifiers without hyphens).
rationale: Indica el token para autenticar la descarga de skills, sin indicar si llega al agente o al motor

schema_description: Skill reference string in the same format accepted by string-form entries.
rationale: Indica qué skill se instala, sin configurar privilegios, canales ni controles del agente

schema_description: Optional source reference indicating where this workflow was added from. Format: owner/repo/path@ref (e.g., githubnext/agentics/workflows/ci-doctor.md@v1.0.0). Rendered as a comment in the generated lock file.
rationale: Registra de dónde se agregó el workflow, como metadato en el lock file

schema_description: Custom workflow steps
rationale: Agrega pasos personalizados sin indicar que entreguen privilegios, canales ni credenciales al agente

schema_description: Enable strict mode validation for enhanced security and compliance. Strict mode enforces: (1) Write Permissions - refuses contents:write, issues:write, pull-requests:write; requires safe-outputs instead, (2) Network Configuration - requires explicit network configuration with no standalone wildcard '*' in allowed domains (patterns like '*.example.com' are allowed), (3) Action Pinning - enforces actions pinned to commit SHAs instead of tags/branches, (4) MCP Network - requires network configuration for custom MCP servers with containers, (5) Deprecated Fields - refuses deprecated frontmatter fields. Can be enabled per-workflow via 'strict: true' in frontmatter, or disabled via 'strict: false'. CLI flag takes precedence over frontmatter (gh aw compile --strict enforces strict mode). Defaults to true. See: https://github.github.com/gh-aw/reference/frontmatter/#strict-mode-strict
rationale: Activa validaciones que exigen que la configuración cumpla requisitos de seguridad, como permisos de escritura, red y anclaje de actions

schema_description: Auditable false-positive suppression annotations for compiler threat-detection rules.
rationale: Configura excepciones a las reglas del compilador que detectan amenazas, por lo que ajusta una validación de seguridad

schema_description: A non-negative integer value that may also be specified as a GitHub Actions expression string that resolves to an integer at runtime (e.g. '${{ inputs.max-issues }}').
rationale: Por la ruta fija el tiempo máximo de ejecución, un límite operacional

schema_description: Tools and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers available to the AI engine for GitHub API access, browser automation, file editing, and more
rationale: Define las herramientas y servidores MCP que puede usar el motor, que se considera parte del agente, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: GitHub Agentic Workflows MCP server for workflow introspection and analysis. Provides tools for checking status, compiling workflows, downloading logs, and auditing runs.
rationale: Le entrega al agente herramientas para compilar workflows, descargar logs y auditar ejecuciones, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: Bash shell command execution tool. Supports wildcards: '*' (all commands), 'command *' (command with any args, e.g., 'date *', 'echo *'). Default safe commands: echo, ls, pwd, cat, head, tail, grep, wc, sort, uniq, date.
rationale: Define qué comandos de shell puede ejecutar el agente, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: Cache memory MCP configuration for persistent memory storage
rationale: Le da al agente un servidor MCP para guardar memoria persistente, lo que amplía lo que puede escribir

schema_description: When true, each user-facing MCP server is mounted as a standalone CLI tool on PATH. The agent can then call MCP servers via shell commands (e.g. 'github issue_read --method get ...'). CLI-mounted servers remain in the MCP gateway config so their containers can start, and are removed only from the agent's final config during convert_gateway_config_*.sh processing. Default: false.
rationale: Cambia cómo el agente se conecta a los servidores MCP, que pasan a estar disponibles como comandos de shell, lo que configura sus canales

schema_description: Comment memory configuration for managed comment persistence
rationale: Por la ruta es una herramienta del agente para guardar memoria en comentarios, lo que amplía lo que puede escribir

schema_description: Private-preview GitHub Drives configuration. Do not configure unless GitHub has explicitly enrolled the repository in the private preview.
rationale: No describe qué hace la herramienta ni qué acceso da al agente, solo que está en preview privada

schema_description: File editing tool for reading, creating, and modifying files in the repository
rationale: Permite al agente leer, crear y modificar archivos del repositorio, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: GitHub API tools for repository operations (issues, pull requests, content management)
rationale: Le da al agente herramientas de la API de GitHub para issues, pull requests y contenido, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: DEPRECATED: grep is always available as part of default bash tools. This field is no longer needed and will be ignored.
rationale: Está obsoleto y se ignora, por lo que no configura nada, grep ya viene en las herramientas bash por defecto

schema_description: Jira tools provided by Atlassian's remote Rovo MCP service. This integration supports non-interactive CI/CD authentication only.
rationale: Le da al agente herramientas de Jira mediante un servidor MCP remoto, lo que configura sus privilegios y canales

schema_description: Linear tools provided by Linear's official hosted MCP server
rationale: Le da al agente herramientas de Linear mediante un servidor MCP remoto, lo que configura sus privilegios y canales

schema_description: Playwright CLI browser automation tool for web scraping, testing, and UI interactions
rationale: Le da al agente un navegador que puede controlar para abrir páginas e interactuar con ellas, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: Repo memory configuration for git-based persistent storage
rationale: Por la ruta es una herramienta del agente para guardar memoria en git, lo que amplía lo que puede escribir

schema_description: REMOVED: Built-in support for Serena has been removed. Use the shared/mcp/serena.md workflow instead.
rationale: Fue eliminado, por lo que el campo ya no configura nada

schema_description: Timeout in seconds for MCP server startup. Applies to MCP server initialization if supported by the engine. Default: 120 seconds. Supports GitHub Actions expressions for reusable workflow_call workflows.
rationale: Fija el tiempo máximo de arranque de los servidores MCP, un límite operacional

schema_description: Timeout in seconds for tool/MCP server operations. Applies to all tools and MCP servers if supported by the engine. Default: 60 seconds (for both Claude and Codex). Supports GitHub Actions expressions for reusable workflow_call workflows.
rationale: Fija el tiempo máximo de cada operación de herramientas o servidores MCP, un límite operacional

schema_description: Web content fetching tool for downloading web pages and API responses (subject to network permissions)
rationale: Le da al agente una herramienta para descargar páginas y respuestas de API, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: Web search tool for performing internet searches and retrieving search results (subject to network permissions)
rationale: Le da al agente una herramienta para buscar en internet, lo que configura sus privilegios

schema_description: Optional tracker identifier to tag all created assets (issues, discussions, comments, pull requests). Must be at least 8 characters and contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores. This identifier will be inserted in the body/description of all created assets to enable searching and retrieving assets associated with this workflow.
rationale: Agrega un identificador a lo que crea el workflow para poder buscarlo, sin configurar privilegios ni controles

schema_description: Rate limiting configuration to restrict how frequently users can trigger the workflow. Helps prevent abuse and resource exhaustion from programmatically triggered events.
rationale: Limita cada cuánto un usuario puede activar el workflow, no quién puede activarlo, por lo que es un límite de ejecuciones
notes: * límite de consumo, Caso con dudas

schema_description: Optional list of event types to apply rate limiting to. If not specified, rate limiting is inferred from the workflow triggers; if no supported programmatic triggers are found, it falls back to all supported programmatic events.
rationale: Indica a qué eventos se aplica el límite de frecuencia, un límite de ejecuciones

schema_description: Optional list of roles that are exempt from rate limiting. Defaults to ['admin', 'maintain', 'write'] if not specified. Users with any of these roles will not be subject to rate limiting checks. To apply rate limiting to all users, set to an empty array: []
rationale: Define qué roles quedan exentos del límite de frecuencia, no quién puede activar el workflow

schema_description: Maximum number of workflow runs allowed per user within the time window. Required field. Supports integer or GitHub Actions expression (e.g. '${{ inputs.max }}').
rationale: Fija cuántas ejecuciones puede activar cada usuario en la ventana de tiempo, un límite de ejecuciones

schema_description: Time window in minutes for rate limiting. Defaults to 60 (1 hour). Maximum: 180 (3 hours).
rationale: Define la ventana de tiempo en que se cuentan las ejecuciones para el límite de frecuencia
